notes: Three routes are read as the text orders them; the Shu'ba routes are tangled (the Waki' route names «محمد بن أبي المجالد» inside it), so the reading is a doubt for review
«وسألت ابن أبزى فقال مثل ذلك» gives the same saying through another Companion: a variant group, never a route
Ibn Abi Awfa is the last link: he answers the sent narrator (narrated encounter, rule 6); Ibn Abi al-Majalid and Muhammad are not merged
